about: The alleluia of the formulary “Saints Philip and James, Apostles” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Alleluia, alleluia. The heavens proclaim Your wonders, O Lord, and Your faithfulness, in the assembly of the holy ones. Alleluia. Have I been so long a time with you, and you have not known Me? Philip, he who sees Me, sees also My Father. Alleluia.
